svg.title: KKM shrinker: a Scherk-based construction picture
svg.desc: Two views of one connected illustrative surface: spherical caps, an inner disk and an outer sheet joined by a periodic Scherk belt. The cutaway exposes the interior. This is not a solved shrinker.

g.text: Sphere–plane desingularization through a periodic Scherk belt
Connected surface with one outer sheet
Cutaway: inner disk and lower cap
Illustration: k = 9 periods, model genus k − 1 = 8. The end waviness is illustrative.
The theorem applies to sufficiently large genus; no numerical threshold is asserted.
CONSTRUCTION SCHEMATIC · not a solved self-shrinker · outer edge is a display truncation
